messages:
sam: heads-up — trying to push prod release web-frontend@2.14.1 and the deploy is failing with an MFA error from the deployer role. deploy-bot shows `403 MFA_REQUIRED` in the logs. anyone oncall who can grant temporary JIT or advise?

deploy-bot: Deploy #2857 -> web-frontend@2.14.1 FAILED: 403 MFA_REQUIRED. logs: `auth: access denied, policy: require_mfa`. See https://deploys.redwood.internal/2857

nina: @sam thanks for flagging. are you using your user creds or the deployer service account?

sam: deploying from my laptop using `rwd-deploy` CLI (user token). I think our recent policy change now enforces MFA for deploys from new IPs. I just moved regions.

chris: I can jump in. if we need to get this out now we have two quick options: 1) request a 1h JIT elevation for @sam, 2) switch to the reserved deployer host (ci-deployer) which has a bound service account. which is faster?

sam: switching to ci-deployer would be slower because the build needs to re-run. a 1h JIT would unblock faster.

jen: security here. MFA exceptions are allowed only with an approver in security or infra present + an audit ticket. if you need JIT, ping me and include justification. we also need an entry in the deploy audit log and the release notes for the exemption.

oliver: I can grant a 1h JIT via `rbacctl` if @jen signs off. command I will run: ```rbacctl grant --principal=sam --role=deployer --duration=1h --reason="hotfix web-frontend fail: MFA block"```

nina: @jen please confirm so oliver can proceed. also we should pin the release and mention the pin in the notes: `web-frontend:2.14.1 (pinned after emergency JIT)`

jen: approved. justification: hotfix for customer-facing 502s in EU region after infra rollout. oliver go ahead but include `ticket:SEC-4789` in the reason and set retention to 90d.

oliver: done. ran `rbacctl grant --principal=sam --role=deployer --duration=1h --reason="hotfix web-frontend fail: MFA block; ticket:SEC-4789"`. sharing the CLI output: `GRANT OK: id=grant_9f3b`

deploy-bot: Deploy resumed for #2857. streaming logs: initializing -> uploading -> activating -> SUCCESS. rollout to prod started at 2026-03-20T15:12:03Z

sam: deploy succeeded. thanks @oliver and @jen. note for release notes: 2.14.1 includes EU hotfix and we pinned the image while we investigate why MFA kicked new tokens.

chris: follow-ups: 1) update runbook section "prod deploy MFA" with steps for JIT and who to ping (include security rotation contact), 2) add automated hint in deploy CLI when MFA_REQUIRED suggests region/session issues, 3) retrospective to decide if we need a 'no-MFA' reserved host for scheduled maintenance windows.

jen: agreed. I'm creating SEC-4790 to track a postmortem and policy tweak. enforce: add checklist item to releases: `confirm MFA device registered` and `confirm IP range` for cross-region deploys.

nina: I'll update the release checklist and add the pinned-version note to the release notes PR. also adding a blurb in the deployer runbook.

alice: bonus: I added a quick `rwd-deploy` warning in the CLI for MFA errors that points to the runbook. will open PR shortly.

sam: thanks everyone. closing this thread once the release notes PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
